breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use the same roller direction (u_x = 0) on both vertical edges, contradicting the initial request for asymmetric support. The generated specification correctly ignored this error and implemented the asymmetric constraints as defined in the ground truth: 'Apply a constraint fixing vertical displacement (u_y = 0) on the left edge' and 'Apply a constraint fixing horizontal displacement (u_x = 0) on the right edge.'
